rule: A waiver is an explicit owner exception, never a pass. A waived gate stays ok=false and is printed as WAIVED; the audit only returns success for it when run with --accept-waivers, and even then it says the release is not fully shippable. Delete an entry to restore the hard gate.

waivers.reason: Owner decided not to wait for the 24 h window and to ship on the evidence collected so far.
not_proven: No 24 h continuous window has been observed for this build; the recorded window had 0.4 of 24.0 h elapsed.
Absence of dropped rows, restarts, DEGRADED reports and SCM 7031/7034 events is proven only for the observed fraction of the window.
The 24 h claim cannot be reconstructed later from this artifact; a future window must be run separately if the claim is ever needed.
